verdict.rationale: Vue's docs state it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript, implying it renders real DOM elements rather than a virtual canvas or native widget tree, which supports the story indirectly. However, none of the evidence explicitly mentions the browser DevTools extension, DOM inspection workflow, or confirms real DOM output versus other rendering targets. Missing for 10: explicit mention of Vue DevTools browser extension, explicit confirmation of real DOM node rendering, and independent/hands-on corroboration of debugging via browser devtools.
